propositions: N=3000 import benchmark calls author() 6,001 times, each invoking subprocess-backed git config user.name lookup, consuming 47.79s and dominating wall time (77–108s).
batch_stage_and_commit calls sweep_stale_staging once per CREATE ticket (3,000 times), rescanning the same staging root repeatedly within a batch while items remain unpublished, consuming 15.94s.
author cache must remain scoped to import context only; interactive/direct writes require live per-call lookup to preserve user.name mutability and fallback semantics across independent sessions.
stale sweep must reduce to at most one per batch for first new-ticket CREATE; empty and existing-ticket-only batches must not add new sweeps; direct stage_event callers retain default sweep behavior.
profiled A/B identical-state replacement of only these two collaborators (git-config, sweep) removed 60.8s (78.8%) without changing event bytes, attribution, commit count, or 24-commit contract.

locked N=3000 test contract (left-changeful-mamba) requires exactly 24 commits, >=10x reduction, idempotency, crash-resume, and rollback; optimization must not weaken these assertions or introduce timing thresholds.
